description: Source code for a PHP class 'trello' implementing a minimal Trello API client, including methods for retrieving and adding issues and notes, and fetching board and list data.

classes.name: trello
classes.description: A PHP class providing a minimal interface to Trello's REST API, including methods for managing cards, comments, and fetching board/list info.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing the Trello API client with context and optional configuration.

methods.name: getIssueURL
methods.description: Retrieves the URL of a Trello card (issue) by its ID.

methods.name: getIssue
methods.description: Fetches detailed information about a specific Trello card by ID.

methods.name: addIssue
methods.description: Creates a new Trello card with a given title and description.

methods.name: addNote
methods.description: Adds a comment/note to a specified Trello card.

methods.name: getBoard
methods.description: Retrieves information about the Trello board associated with the client.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Fetches details of a specific Trello list by ID.
